gloss: to inhale; to suck in; to absorb

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {吸|す}い{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {吸|す}い{込|こ}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {吸|す}い{込|こ}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To draw air or a gas into the lungs through the nose or mouth.

definitions.gloss: to suck in; to draw in
definitions.explanation: To pull something inward through suction, such as a vacuum cleaner drawing in dust or a drain drawing in water.
To take in and retain liquid or other substances, as a sponge absorbs water.

FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧ (to inhale, suck) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into)

The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ pattern indicates drawing something inward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to inhale air
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to inhale smoke
- ⟦ほこり→埃：03624_hokori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to suck in dust
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to absorb moisture

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing being inhaled or absorbed.
